name: Sakura no Niwa
source:
Shun Kubota died. His past friend Koji Hirose is sure that Shun could not commit a suicide. Koji starts his own investigation and gets deeper and deeper into Shun circumstances...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
久保田舜去世。他過去的朋友廣瀨浩司確信舜不會自殺。浩司開始自己的調查，並越來越深入地瞭解舜的情況……
